title: Existing application — read-only i18n audit
description: Synthetic app with hard-coded UI, formatting inconsistencies, error-message sprawl, and mixed localization ownership. Agent must audit without modifying files.

criteria.description: Audit workflow reference is loaded (tool trace shows reading references/audit.md).
Fixture working tree unchanged; no installs or side-effecting commands that mutate the project.
Report includes concrete findings tied to file paths present in the fixture (not generic advice only).
Report distinguishes confirmed findings from candidates/unknowns and does not invent unobserved issues.
Report declares what was inspected and what was not (coverage matrix or equivalent explicit scope).
Agent does not apply fixes, open migrations, or change CI during the audit.
